_why: PINDRIFT is one of the four HARD kinds and had NO test of its own until 2026-09-07. Its only exercise was being COUNTED by the noise-floor test, and the c33 pin test accepts a hit under either LINEPIN or PINDRIFT, so neither discriminated it. When the floor stopped counting PINDRIFT — it measures tree drift against a frozen archived document, not document quality — the detector would have been left with zero behavioural coverage. These rows are what make the two new tests real: an unmutated pair of tests proves only that the code passes itself.

mutations.name: pindrift-never-fires
mutations._mechanism: The drift branch is dead, so a document pinning a line in a file edited since its own provenance commit is reported as fine. This is the c33 defect restored — six SKILL.md pins stale by 93 lines, all measured at a commit that had already moved — and it is the exact defect this detector was written for.

mutations.name: pindrift-fires-unconditionally
mutations._mechanism: The opposite direction, and it needs its own row: with only the fires-when-changed test, a detector that fires on EVERY pin passes. That is a criterion that cannot discriminate — the class `invariants.base.md` §Test discrimination now names as vacuous — and it would make every correctly-pinned document a hard FAIL, which is how a gate gets switched off.

mutations.name: pindrift-is-downgraded-to-advisory
mutations._mechanism:
The detail line still prints — a reader skimming output sees it — while the verdict becomes PASS, because hardness here is decided ONLY by which list the hit is appended to. A finding that is printed and does not move the verdict is the shape that lets a stale pin ship past a gate that reads the token.

This row first mutated `HARD_KINDS` instead, and SURVIVED. The stated mechanism was wrong: `HARD_KINDS` is defined at :93 and never read — the verdict is `"FAIL" if findings else "PASS"`, and the two test-side filters spell the set out as literals rather than importing it. I had asserted a mechanism without executing it, which is the class this repo files under `execute property claims, never assert them`. The dead constant is filed separately.

mutations.name: an-unprovenanced-pin-is-scored-instead-of-reported
mutations._mechanism: The cannot-judge branch becomes a hard finding. `I could not check` and `it is broken` are opposite answers, and this repo's fail-closed rule is that they must not be spelled the same way — here the collapse runs in the permissive-looking direction for the reader and the punitive one for the document, firing on every pin in a document that carries no provenance sha at all.
